These notes cover the theoretical and mathematical foundations of diffusion and flow-based generative models.

## 1. Theoretical Foundation

The various definitions of the diffusion and flow-based generative learning process.

### 1.1 [Score Matching with Langevin Dynamics (SMLD)](theoretical_foundation/smld.qmd)

Score matching as a foundation for generative modeling.

### 1.2 [Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM)](theoretical_foundation/ddpm.qmd)

The noise prediction formulation, including the forward diffusion process, reverse denoising process, and training objective.

### 1.3 [Stochastic Differential Equations (SDEs) Formulation](theoretical_foundation/sde.qmd)

The continuous-time formulation of DMs through forward and reverse-time stochastic differential equations.

### 1.4 [Elucidated Diffusion Models (EDMs)](theoretical_foundation/edm.qmd)

Decoupling the noise schedules and other hyperparameters from the previous formulations.

### 1.5 [Cold-Diffusion (CD)](theoretical_foundation/cold_diffusion.qmd)

DMs with more general corruption schemes.
